ollama_exposure.description: Detects if Ollama API is exposed beyond localhost (0.0.0.0, [::], LAN IP, or non-loopback OLLAMA_HOST in process/user/machine env)

mcp_package_integrity.description: Checks MCP server npm packages for known malicious indicators (supply chain RAT detection)

claude_code_permissions.description: Audits Claude Code CLI file access scope and config

suspicious_processes.description: Detects AI-tool-spawned processes with suspicious network or file behavior

clipboard_exfil.description: Monitors clipboard for sensitive data patterns when AI tools are active

browser_extension_audit.description: Audits Chrome/Edge extensions for AI-adjacent risky permissions

localhost_port_scan.description: Detects unexpected localhost services spun up by AI tools

env_secrets_exposure.description: Checks for API keys exposed in env vars, .env files, or shell history

network_beaconing.description: Detects unusual outbound connections from AI tool processes

mcp_injection_exposure.description: Expects high-privilege MCP servers (shell/registry/filesystem) to be OFF - when on, prompt injection in content Claude reads can act on this PC
